newsitem.title: USA: Walbro sees Q3 EPS likely below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Walbro sees Q3 EPS likely below estimates.

text.p: Walbro Corp said Thursday it expects its earnings for the third quarter to be $0.27 a share, below earlier analysts' consensus estiamtes.

"Third quarter earnings are expected to be $0.27 per share," L. E. Althaver, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement. "Earlier analysts' estimates had been in the $0.30 to $0.37 per share range."
In the third quarter of 1995, Walbro, which designs and makes precision fuel systems and products for automotive and small engines markets, earned $0.27 a share.

"Production at Walbro Automotive's new plastic fuel tank facility in Brazil was scheduled to begin in the third quarter. However, delays in customer programs postponed production, which is now expected to begin in November," Althaver said. "Inefficiencies due to the transfer of tank production to a new plant in Belgium are also expected to reduce margins in the quarter."

He added earnings also were affected by a slower than expected ramp-up of carburetor production at its new plant in China. In addition, third quarter orders for lawn-and-garden products were below normal seasonal levels due to wetter and milder than usual spring and summer weather, he said.
"We expect improved earnings in the fourth quarter, exceeding those of the fourth quarter of 1995," Althaver said.
In the fourth quarter of 1995, Walbro earned $0.30 a share.

"Increased operating efficiencies at our plants, especially at our Belgian facility, will improve earnings. Automotive orders for the quarter are strong," Althaver said. "In addition, demand for Walbro's lawn and garden products should return to normal levels in the quarter."
